title: Amid Freezing Cold, Ladakh Votes In Panchayat, Municipal Polls

ai.summary: Ladakh residents voted in panchayat and municipal polls amid freezing temperatures, as the statehood movement continues.

facts.claim: Ladakh residents voted in panchayat and municipal polls
facts.quote: Amid Freezing Cold, Ladakh Votes In Panchayat, Municipal Polls

ai.background_note: Ladakh, a union territory without a legislature since 2019, wants the same constitutional status as tribal areas in four north-eastern states under the Sixth Schedule.
